hook: Ranking the most painful golf fails from 5 to 1!

items.line: Number 5: Whiffing completely and swinging right through empty air.
Number 4: Driving the golf cart straight through a pond at full speed.
Number 3: Getting stuck in the sand trap for swing after swing.
Number 2: Hurling the club into the trees after one bad shot.
Number 1: Shanking the ball directly into the crowd, twice in a row!
